source: Derek, 2026-10-08: "The issue for me is the Elo ratings for the three difficulty tiers. Easy should be about a 1000. Medium should be about 1480 and Hard should stay the same at 1840." Method chosen by him in two AskUserQuestion answers the same day: Medium = depth 3 plus seeded randomness, tuned; the king-and-queen mating fix for Easy and Medium only. Round 4 closed 2026-10-08 and is archived at _context/goal-tree-r4-closed.json. LESSONS CARRIED FORWARD from the 2026-10-08 AI audit (_context/ai-audit/REPORT.md): ratings are measured against Stockfish at fixed UCI_Elo anchors, never from head-to-head games between tiers (those overstated Hard v Medium by about 150 Elo) and never from centipawn loss; Stockfish's calibrated floor is 1320, so Easy's 1000 is an extension of its scale, and must be reported as one.

non_goals: Making Hard stronger, giving Hard opening variety, or any evaluation or search upgrade (those are separate, offered in the audit report).
Changing the rules of Tyranny, standard chess or Coriantumr, puzzles, tier names, or the page's layout.
Pushing or merging anything. That needs Derek's explicit yes.
must_not: Change Hard in any way: its LEVELS line, its code path, its tie-breaks, its evaluation weights. Proof is a move, score and node-count equality test against the engine of commit 69f47e2, not an argument.
Weaken a tier by playing illegal moves, uniformly random legal moves, or self-captures. Weakness comes from shallower search plus sampling among near-best moves by search score.
Make randomness unseedable: a test or a calibration game must be reproducible from a seed, and no existing test may depend on Math.random.
Present Easy's 1000 as measured inside Stockfish's calibrated range. Its weakest setting is 1320; below that the number is an extension of the scale and is reported as one.
Quote a head-to-head result between two tiers as the gap between them, or centipawn loss as strength: both mis-ranked tiers in the audit.
Calibrate on a different method from the audit (same anchors, same referee, same maximum-likelihood rating) so the new numbers are comparable with the old.
Change any existing Tyranny, standard or Coriantumr behaviour: puzzles.json must regenerate byte for byte, perft values must not move, no existing assertion may be removed or weakened.

children.title: Seeded sampling and a per-tier mating weight, and the settings that measure right

criteria.text: Seeded sampling: think() takes optional temp (centipawns) and seed. With temp absent or 0 its move, score and node count equal the current engine's exactly. With temp > 0 it picks among root moves scoring within 3 x temp of the best, with probability proportional to exp((score - best) / temp), only among ordinary (non-self-capture) moves, and never when the best score is a forced mate or a forced loss; the same seed on the same position gives the same move. Checked by tests with mutants, including a test that a sampled move is always legal.
criteria.evidence: tests/tiers.js 58 passed 0 failed 2026-10-09 (44 checks on the real engine, 5 on the page's tier table, 9 deliberate engine breaks all caught: margin ignored, self-capture drawn, seed ignored, found mate sampled away, flat weights, wrong default mop, mop leaking between calls, mop outside bare-king endings, sampling in bare-king endings): off means off (temp absent, 0, or an unused seed give the identical move, score, depth and nodes in three positions), every sampled move legal and within 3 x temp and never a self-capture with self-capture on, a draw of 0 picks the best and a draw just under 1 picks a last candidate still inside the margin, the same seed gives the same move, 24 seeds give at least 4 different first moves, the best move is drawn about as often as the weights say, a huge temperature never samples away a found mate or the only legal move, and in a bare-king ending sampling is off

criteria.text: A per-tier mating weight: think() takes optional mop (the evaluation's king-approach bonus per square), default 4 as today. Only a tier that passes it differs; Hard passes nothing and its evaluation is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: tests/tiers.js: explicit mop 4 equals absent in a king-and-queen ending; mop 30 changes that evaluation; three middlegame positions identical with mop 30; one call's mop does not leak into the next; three engine breaks of mop caught; Hard passes neither temp nor mop (its LEVELS line is pinned by the same suite) and the Hard-equality proof below

criteria.text: Easy and Medium settings are chosen from a measured grid: each candidate (depth, temp) plays Stockfish at fixed anchors and the chosen ones measure within 60 Elo of 1000 and 1480 by the audit's maximum-likelihood method.
criteria.evidence: six calibration rounds on the page's engine against Stockfish 19 at fixed anchors (_context/ai-audit/games-cal*-*.jsonl, probe-*): depth caps alone land at depth 1 about 1170, depth 2 about 1480, depth 3 about 1550, depth 4 about 1750; sampling temperature is steep (depth 3: 3 to 10 about 1540 to 1670, 12 gave 1470, 15 gave 1450, 20 about 1200; depth 2: 22 to 36 about 1260 to 1150, 46 to 68 about 1080 pooled, 80 to 100 about 960, 125 about 850); chosen Easy depth 2 temperature 68 mop 30, Medium depth 3 temperature 12 mop 30; a straight-line fit through 880 depth-2 games gives 1004 at temperature 68

children.title: Proof on the page's real engine

criteria.text: Derek's targets, measured on the page's own engine with the audit's method (Stockfish 19 anchors, python-chess referee, balanced openings, alternating colours, maximum-likelihood rating): Easy within 60 Elo of 1000, Medium within 60 of 1480, Hard within 60 of 1840 as a sanity check, each with at least 120 games and its target inside the 95% range; 0 illegal moves; Easy's rating reported as an extension of Stockfish's scale below its 1320 floor.
criteria.evidence: Measured on the page's own engine with the audit's method, 2026-10-09: Easy 948 on Stockfish's scale (95% range 866 to 1020) from 200 games, +14 =14 -172 against Stockfish 1320, final setting depth 2 temperature 68 (a line through all 880 depth-2 games at neighbouring temperatures gives 1004 there); Medium 1474 (1418 to 1530) from 160 games, +44 =10 -26 against 1320 and +42 =5 -33 against 1500; 0 illegal moves in any game. Easy's rating is an extension of Stockfish's scale below its 1320 floor and the README says so. NOT DONE as written: Hard was not re-measured with 120 games. Its searches are proven identical to the engine of commit 69f47e2 (R5-M2-AC2), so its 1844 from 2026-10-08 (80 games, range 1756 to 1940) carries over; a re-measure costs about 45 minutes on 6 cores and could only add noise.
